in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tom הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin 'Thomas' meaning 'twin'. This name is popular in the English-speaking world.

in_latin.name: Thomas
in_latin.meaning: from twin, named after twin brother, Hebrew origin, biblical reference, twin of Jesus
in_latin.long_meaning: Thomas, meaning 'twin', originates from the Aramaic word 'teoma', derived from the Hebrew word 'tehom', meaning 'twins'. In the New Testament, Thomas is one of Jesus' twelve apostles and is known for his doubts and faith. In Christian tradition, Thomas is often referred to as 'Doubting Thomas' due to his request to touch Jesus' wounds after the Resurrection. In modern times, Thomas is a popular name across various Christian cultures, symbolizing the complexities of faith and the importance of questioning and seeking truth.
